Question: allah help you in your work. I want to become shcolar of islam and also in duniya. I have a problem with my memory and my self. I can't remember anything not even a one line answer. I know english but i can't speak fluently, i can't write, i can't think, i can't understand etc I have lack of logic, mathematics etc skills. I have failed in six standard three times and in tenth standard two times and in elevan standard one time. now i am studying in my HSC.plz give me some technique of memorising and dua to memorise. please HELP. Answer ID: 11309 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 560/560=M/1430) For good memory, recite ya Qawi ( یا قوی ) after every salah resting the hands at head. Also, pray to Allah for the same and avoid things leading to forgetfulness. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
